screening_decisions.reason: Review article discussing diagnosis, natural history, and management of traumatic macular holes. Not an RCT comparing ILM peeling vs inverted ILM flap.
Review article discussing retinal damage from ILM peeling. Not an RCT comparing surgical techniques.
Systematic review and meta-analysis, not an RCT. Although it compares inverted ILM flap vs ILM peeling for large MHs, the study design does not meet criteria.
Prospective observational case series studying Stage 1-A macular hole morphology. Not an RCT comparing surgical techniques.
Retrospective study comparing phacovitrectomy vs vitrectomy alone. Does not compare ILM peeling vs inverted ILM flap.
Meta-analysis, not an RCT. Although it compares ILM peeling vs inverted flap, the study design does not meet criteria.
Classification system development paper. Not an RCT.
Retrospective comparative study (not RCT) analyzing medical records of patients with idiopathic MHs >450 µm. Study design does not meet RCT criteria.
Retrospective longitudinal cohort study examining incidence and risk factors. Not an RCT.
Meta-analysis of RCTs, not an RCT itself. Study design does not meet criteria.
Systematic review and single-arm meta-analysis. Not an RCT.
Review article about cataract formation after vitrectomy. Not an RCT.
Experimental study in monkeys investigating mechanism of MH closure. Not an RCT in humans.
Population-based retrospective chart review. Not an RCT.
Methodological paper about risk of bias assessment tool. Not an RCT.
Review article. Not an RCT.
RCT comparing classic inverted ILM flap vs modified inverted ILM flap (no extra manipulation). Both groups use inverted ILM flap technique; does not compare ILM peeling vs inverted ILM flap.
Methodological paper about search strategies for RCTs. Not an RCT.
RCT comparing two variations of inverted ILM flap technique (temporal vs classic). Does not compare ILM peeling vs inverted ILM flap.

Prospective RCT comparing standard ILM peel vs inverted ILM flap technique for large idiopathic MHs (minimum linear dimension ≥600 µm). Meets all selection criteria: RCT design, compares ILM peeling vs inverted ILM flap, large MHs.
Observational comparative study examining vascular changes after vitreoretinal surgery for iERM vs MH. Not an RCT comparing ILM peeling vs inverted ILM flap.
Review article summarizing natural history, clinical staging, and pathogenesis. Not an RCT.
Systematic review and IPD meta-analysis comparing ILM peeling vs no peeling. Not an RCT, and does not compare ILM peeling vs inverted ILM flap.
RCT comparing vitrectomy vs observation alone. Does not compare ILM peeling vs inverted ILM flap.
Epidemiological study examining prevalence of visual impairment. Not an RCT.

Prospective RCT comparing standard vitrectomy (with complete ILM removal/peeling) vs inverted ILM flap technique for MHs >400 µm. The abstract indicates Group 1 underwent standard technique while Group 2 had inverted ILM flap where 'instead of completely removing the ILM...a remnant was left in place', implying Group 1 had complete ILM peeling. Meets selection criteria.
Retrospective consecutive noncomparative case series. Not an RCT.
Comparative study (not explicitly an RCT) comparing complete ILM removal vs inverted ILM flap for myopic macular holes. Abstract does not state randomization was performed.
Brief article proposing a theory of macular hole formation. Not an RCT.
RCT comparing PRP vs inverted ILM flap for large MHs (600-1500 µm). Does not compare ILM peeling vs inverted ILM flap.
Epidemiological prevalence study. Not an RCT.
Statistical methodology paper. Not an RCT.
Review/commentary article. Not an RCT.
Classification system development paper. Not an RCT.

Prospective RCT comparing multilayered inverted ILM flap vs standard ILM peeling for large macular holes. Meets all selection criteria: RCT design, compares ILM peeling vs inverted ILM flap variant, large MHs.
Observational study reviewing 158 eyes with evolving or completed idiopathic macular holes. Not an RCT.
Retrospective chart review of 550 patients. Not an RCT.
Comparative study (not RCT) of 24 eyes comparing inverted ILM flap vs conventional ILM peeling for large MHs (≥400 µm). Abstract does not state randomization was performed.
Comparative study (not RCT) of 34 patients comparing ILM removal vs temporal inverted ILM flap. Abstract does not state randomization was performed.

Prospective RCT comparing ILM peeling vs inverted ILM flap for idiopathic large FTMH (minimum diameter 600-1500 µm). Meets all selection criteria: RCT design, compares ILM peeling vs inverted ILM flap, large MHs.
Statistical methodology paper about heterogeneity measures in meta-analysis. Not an RCT.
Review article. Not an RCT.
Meta-analysis of RCTs, not an RCT itself. Study design does not meet criteria.
Observational study about pathogenesis and early stages. Not an RCT.
RCT comparing two variants of inverted ILM flap technique (Cover vs Fill). Does not compare ILM peeling vs inverted ILM flap. Additionally, average MH diameter was 397 µm (<400 µm, not large MHs).
RCT comparing inverted ILM flap vs subretinal aspiration technique. Does not compare ILM peeling vs inverted ILM flap.
Review article. Not an RCT.
Comparative study (not explicitly an RCT) comparing ILM flat covering (transplantation) vs ILM stripping for giant IMH and high myopia MH. Abstract does not state randomization was performed.
RCT comparing extended ILM dissection vs standard ILM dissection. Does not compare ILM peeling vs inverted ILM flap.
Epidemiological study examining prevalence of epiretinal membranes. Not an RCT.
